JSON
    foo: {bar: {baz: {quux: {corge: "plugh"}}}, quuz: {garply: "xyzzy", thud: {wibble: "wobble"}}}
        bar: {baz: {quux: {corge: "plugh"}}}

                    corge: "plugh"
        quuz: {garply: "xyzzy", thud: {wibble: "wobble"}}
            garply: "xyzzy"
            thud: {wibble: "wobble"}
                wibble: "wobble"
